decisions.text: type table: a table alone: its sole use is importing the values into another program (facts.message export_only; G1.12)

a table alone, formatted in the book's order: the digits the purpose needs, two thin rules, space between rows and columns, the numbers right-aligned to be compared, nothing bold but the title, the unit once in the title (08-12 DP-4, G7.37–G7.45)
digits: to the measure's precision, 1, one number of decimals down each column (G7.37, G6.16)
the totals last under the darker rule, named in the names' column, in regular weight (D-52 (ii)); the printed totals are the data's, never recomputed
Total: a total column, set apart by a wider gutter (30 pt against 15 pt; G7.39s)
the unit once, in the title; the cells bare numbers (G7.45)

source.notes: 08-12 R10-11 (b) (p. 341–343, the rule; the book draws no exported table), DP-3
source.shows: a table alone because its sole use is importing the values into another program (R10-11 (b), the chooser's step 1, facts.message export_only), formatted as any table: a text column of codes left-aligned before the names, every digit, a zero kept as 0 and a count not made as its note, never a zero (R9-7); the totals of the stool's row, of Norwich's column and the grand total add up the counted values only, as the data give them (the printed totals are the data's); synthetic data
